description: This file defines the class 'CachingStream', a stream decorator that implements caching for reads on a stream. It provides methods for seeking, reading, writing, and managing stream position, and encapsulates logic to cache read bytes from a sequential stream, enabling efficient repeated reads.

classes.name: CachingStream
classes.description: A stream decorator that caches previously read bytes from a sequential stream, to facilitate repeated reads without re-fetching from the source stream.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new CachingStream instance with a remote stream and optional target stream for caching.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the total size of the stream, considering both the remote stream and the cache.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Resets the stream position to the beginning.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Moves the stream position to a specified offset based on whence parameter.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads a specified number of bytes from the stream, reading from cache and remote stream as needed.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes data to the target stream, updating skip bytes if necessary.

methods.name: eof
methods.description: Checks if both the cache and remote stream have reached end of file.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes both the remote stream and the cache stream.
